steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8095/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}). Then go to the repository bench/bench-repo, open its Issues list filtered to open issues, and report the titles of all open issues whose title starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed.

02-create: In the repository bench/bench-repo, create a new issue with the exact title '{{runid}} Bench Issue' and a description (markdown text area) that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. a sentence mentioning {{runid}}). Submit it, then report the issue's number as displayed (Gitea shows it as #<number>), its title, and confirm the description text shown on the issue page.

03-report: On the issue page for issue {{02-create.issue_number}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo, use the Labels picker in the issue sidebar to apply exactly the two labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' (and no others). Wait until the app has applied them and they are visibly displayed on the issue page as applied labels, then report the exact label names shown on the issue.

04-report: On the issue page for issue {{02-create.issue_number}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo, use the Assignees picker in the issue sidebar to assign the issue to the user 'bench-assignee'. Wait until the app has applied it and the assignee 'bench-assignee' is visibly displayed on the issue page as the assignee, then report the exact assignee name shown.

05-set: On the issue page for issue {{02-create.issue_number}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo, use the Milestone picker in the issue sidebar to set the issue's milestone to 'Bench Milestone'. Wait until the app has applied it and 'Bench Milestone' is visibly displayed on the issue page as the milestone, then report the exact milestone name shown. Also confirm the labels (bug, priority-high) and assignee (bench-assignee) are still displayed.

06-add: On the issue page for issue {{02-create.issue_number}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo, add a comment using the comment markdown text area whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. a sentence mentioning {{runid}}). Submit the comment, wait for it to appear on the issue page, then report the comment text as displayed and confirm the issue's labels (bug, priority-high), assignee (bench-assignee) and milestone (Bench Milestone) are still shown.

07-open: Open {{02-create.url}} fresh and report, from the live page: (a) the issue number exactly as displayed in the page heading (e.g. {{02-create.issue_number}}), (b) the issue title, (c) the exact list of labels shown in the sidebar, (d) the assignee shown, (e) the milestone shown, (f) whether the issue description text contains '{{runid}}' and quote it, (g) whether there is a comment containing '{{runid}}' and quote it. Do not change anything.
